svg.text: Twelve silences cut into the command endings — three per voice
Each file is the four screened voices laid end to end. The extra-pause version is the same audio, sliced, with silence inserted between the trailing DOOM tokens.
Inserted silence is digitally zero and can be located exactly: the normal file contains none, the extra-pause file contains twelve runs.
19.89 s · speech 12.38 s · no digital silence
21.44 s · speech 12.41 s · 12 inserted silences, 1.46 s
Speech and silence budget, to scale
Speech 12.38 s → 12.41 s, unchanged. Duration +1.55 s, of which 1.46 s is digital silence cut into the four clips — three per clip, 70 to 150 ms each.
